messages:
Samir: Heads-up: OneRetail POC kickoff — need to lock scope, acceptance criteria, and prompt baseline. Customer wants retrieval-augmented summaries + guided QA flow. Main asks: SLA latency <400ms p50 and a monthly cost target. Who can help map prompts & evals? @Elaine @Mohit :wave:

Elaine: I can join. They've defined 3 demo flows: 1) Product description summarization 2) Customer support triage 3) Auto-tagging. We should capture example prompts + desired metrics for each flow. Can we get a sample of their product/support snippets (de-identified)?

Mohit: Please request 100 de-identified examples per flow. For a baseline run we'll do embeddings + rerank -> generate summaries. Suggested evals: ROUGE + BERTScore + human accept rate. Proposed acceptance threshold: 85% human approval over a 200-sample eval set.

Julie: Latency target is going to be tight if sequence lengths exceed ~1k tokens. Need token distribution to estimate. Which model family do we want to start with? My suggestion: start with an open 20B quant variant on Dedicated or our Hosted high-perf instance for iteration. Also enable prefix caching for repeated contexts.

Chris: Pricing note: Dedicated vs Hosted will differ a lot. For Hosted example calc: if avg prompt=800 tokens and avg gen=150 tokens, show me throughput and we'll estimate monthly cost. I'll draft two scenarios once we have sample sizes and QPS.

OpsBot: POC checklist created: `/poc create OneRetail 2026-04-15 owner:@Elaine tasks:[data-share,prompt-inventory,eval-run]` :white_check_mark:

Mohit: For the prompt inventory, start minimal and iterate. Example baseline prompt template to include in the inventory:

```
Summarize the following product description in 3 concise bullet points focusing on key benefits and usage.
Context: {product_text}
Tone: concise, neutral
If information is missing, reply: "not specified".
Max_tokens: 120
```

Also add a negative-example list (hallucination triggers) and an instruction to include source citations when available.

Julie: For the eval harness I'll stand up a quick runner to evaluate n=200 per model variant and capture latency distributions and BERTScore. Need dataset path + label schema (acceptable / needs edit / reject). Can anyone confirm label schema?

Elaine: I'll request 150 samples per flow from OneRetail (de-identified) and confirm data deliverable by Apr 10. Proposed timeline: data by Apr 10, prompt inventory + eval plan by Apr 12, run evals Apr 13-14, demo Apr 20. Can we all ack the timeline? :calendar:

Samir: :thumbsup: Ack. Action items: Mohit draft prompt inventory by Apr 11, Julie prepare eval infra, Chris prepare cost estimates for Hosted and Dedicated. I'll own the security questionnaire and SOW touchpoints. @Julie any blockers for a private/Dedicated test?

Julie: No infra blockers but we'll need VPN + RBAC for Private deploy; security will ask for SOC2 artifacts and KMS integration details. Elaine, please surface any compliance specifics from the customer.

Chris: I'll sketch two pricing scenarios and post numbers here by EOD tomorrow.

Elaine: Thanks all — looping in OneRetail contact Mira (cc) to speed up data share. :raised_hands:
